Job Information

Contract, Addis Ababa; one year, possible renewal; 2 vacancies; deadline Oct 2, 2026

Background

Ethiopian Public Health Institute is the public-sector employer advertising this position in health / data science. The role information below is a source-faithful paraphrase of the identified vacancy, not a verbatim reproduction.

Job Summary / Purpose of the Position

The Senior Data Scientist position supports the organisation’s work in health / data science. The advertisement specifies the education, experience and technical requirements below.

Roles and Responsibilities

Collaborate with public-health teams to convert policy questions into modelling objectives, prediction horizons and validation plans.

Harmonize health, surveillance, climate, survey and geospatial datasets, including boundaries and missing values.

Build Python-based reproducible feature engineering and data preparation workflows.

Develop spatial risk mapping, hotspot and small-area prediction models using leakage-aware spatial validation.

Evaluate CNN, GNN and representation learning where appropriate to available data.

Develop and compare XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM, GRU and transformer-based forecasting models.

Assess calibration, uncertainty, subgroup and geographic robustness, temporal and spatial leakage, and bias.

Deliver documented workflows, dashboards, maps, APIs, policy briefs and manuscripts.

Mentor analysts and work with epidemiologists, policymakers and technical teams while meeting privacy and security requirements.

Qualifications and Experience

PhD in a quantitative discipline plus 2 years, or Master’s plus 6 years of relevant experience. Six public-health peer-reviewed papers, three first-author.

Required and Desired Skills

Python required; R preferred; SQL; spatial ML; deep learning; time-series forecasting; health data; Git and reproducible analysis.

Employment Terms and Application

Contract, Addis Ababa; one year, possible renewal; 2 vacancies; deadline Oct 2, 2026

Senior Bayesian Spatial Modeller and Small Area Estimation Expert

Ethiopian Public Health Institute

Health / Biostatistics | Senior | Ethiopia

Job Information

Contract, Addis Ababa; one year renewable; 1 vacancy; deadline Oct 2, 2026

Background

Ethiopian Public Health Institute is the public-sector employer advertising this position in health / biostatistics. The role information below is a source-faithful paraphrase of the identified vacancy, not a verbatim reproduction.

Job Summary / Purpose of the Position

The Senior Bayesian Spatial Modeller and Small Area Estimation Expert position supports the organisation’s work in health / biostatistics. The advertisement specifies the education, experience and technical requirements below.

Roles and Responsibilities

Frame policy questions by indicator, geography, time period, estimand and decision threshold.

Combine survey, census, routine health, surveillance and geospatial covariates with traceable metadata.

Handle boundary changes, spatial misalignment, displaced survey clusters, missingness and measurement error.

Produce design-based direct estimates and standard errors before model-based estimation.

Fit Fay–Herriot, BYM/BYM2, CAR, Gaussian-process or related Bayesian spatial models as justified.

Use INLA, MCMC, HMC or NUTS and compare model diagnostics, assumptions and sensitivity.

Quantify uncertainty and communicate subnational estimates through maps, reports and policy products.

Train and mentor analysts and support reproducible statistical workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

PhD in statistics, biostatistics, demography, survey methodology or related discipline plus 2 years; or Master’s plus 6 years. Six public-health papers, three first-author.

Required and Desired Skills

Bayesian inference, small area estimation, spatial statistics, R, INLA/Stan, GIS, survey analysis and uncertainty assessment.

Employment Terms and Application

Contract, Addis Ababa; one year renewable; 1 vacancy; deadline Oct 2, 2026
